verification_policy: Correction-first mechanics reconciliation: strengthen the existing Chapter 4 Awoken record only where current acquisition and testing evidence agrees; preserve version-sensitive numeric details as sourced rather than treating community measurements as universal constants.
research_scope: The Power to Overcome — unlock route and two-stage mechanics reconciliation for Future Saga Chapter 4.

verification_audit.method: Compared the existing Batch 36 record against current Chapter 4 official scope, a current transformation-stat testing guide, and current unlock documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: The existing Awoken/Race identity is preserved; this batch refines its unlock and mechanics documentation rather than creating a second transformation record.

verification_audit.unlock_finding: Current Chapter 4 documentation states that The Power to Overcome unlocks automatically after completing the final Chapter 4 story mission, Ultimate All-Out Showdown. No Ultimate Finish condition is involved.
verification_audit.cost_finding: Current testing documentation supports a 500 Ki activation requirement for the transformation. This is treated as activation cost/requirement, not as a persistent per-second Ki drain.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: Independent current testing documents a first stage with defensive and movement benefits, an unblockable sword-style grab replacement, and a second Unleashed stage with very rapid effective Ki recovery and health drain. Exact percentages, durations, and cooldowns remain version-sensitive community measurements and are not promoted as immutable canonical values.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains false because the documented unlock route is completion of the Chapter 4 story/final mission rather than a Parallel Quest reward condition.
verification_audit.cac_policy: usable_by_cac remains true; Chapter 4 documentation identifies the skill as the new Custom Character Awoken Skill.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Complete Future Saga Chapter 4 story and final mission — Ultimate All-Out Showdown
records.source_quest_or_shop: Future Saga Chapter 4 story; Ultimate All-Out Showdown
records.skill_description: A universal Custom Character Awoken Skill introduced with Future Saga Chapter 4. Its first stage provides defensive/mobility utility and a modified unblockable sword-style grab; re-input activates an Unleashed stage with extreme Ki regeneration while draining HP.
records.mechanics_notes: Current testing reports approximately +20% damage reduction and +5% movement speed in the first stage, plus health regeneration below 50% HP and a modified unblockable sword-style grab. Unleashed temporarily provides effectively unlimited/very rapid Ki recovery, stronger basic and Super Attack damage, increased movement speed, and HP drain. Reported exact percentages, 12-second duration, and roughly 24-second re-use cooldown are testing measurements and should remain source-attributed/version-sensitive rather than hard-coded as timeless mechanics.
records.combo_notes: The grab replacement changes normal CaC grab behavior; detailed frame and combo interactions remain separate mechanics research.
records.pve_notes: The transformation is obtained through Chapter 4 story completion rather than a PQ skill-drop table. Unleashed trades health for temporary extreme Ki availability.
records.pvp_notes: Exact frame data and competitive interaction details remain version-sensitive and are not asserted here.
records.correction_reason: The existing Batch 36 record had the correct general story unlock but lacked a precise final-mission identifier and consolidated current mechanics evidence. This correction makes the unlock route explicit, confirms the 500 Ki activation requirement from current testing, and preserves disputed numeric mechanics as version-sensitive rather than canonical constants.
